task.claim:
Let T(z) = (z - d(z))/alpha be a digit step (alpha*T(z) = z - d(z), N(d(z)) <= R)
in an imaginary quadratic order. If every z in the disk -- every z not
satisfying the Outside condition of norm_decrease -- reaches 0 under T, then
every z in O reaches 0: the expansion terminates for every scalar.
